Rotate into IRSX and ELIT for AI-driven enterprise software spend. Maintain WATCH overall until IDX tech breadth confirms a breakout above the 50-day moving average.

Global solar module oversupply pressures margins, yet FSLR's thin-film tech differentiation sustains pricing power in utility-scale projects.

Overall, stay selective: Indonesian names outperform US peers on domestic energy transition catalysts.

Accumulate on dips toward 0.39% aggregate, targeting KIJA and TOWR for 3-6 month upside as government capex accelerates ahead of 2025 elections.

sectors.ai: Healthcare's aggregate uptick is broad-based, not idiosyncratic, with global large-caps (LLY, ABBV, JNJ) and Indonesia's RSGK/LABS confirming a risk-on rotation into defensive growth. Buy pullbacks in CSL (plasma pricing power) and RSGK (domestic hospital consolidation), but trim PODD after its 5.96% pop—valuation is stretched.
